p: Monday, it used for village meetings
Tuesday, it is meeting venue for politicians.
Wednesday, it is a play ground for children.
Thursday, it is used as a village local court.
Friday, it acts as a class for girls by teacher Nabune.
Saturday, it is used as a drinking joint for the elders only.
Sunday, people gather there for prayers.
